title: Lookup by preceding satisfying indices
statement: Let $q$ be a decidable predicate on the natural numbers, and let $n$ and $i$ be natural numbers with $i<n$ and $q(i)$. In the list of numbers less than $n$ that satisfy $q$, the entry at position equal to the number of indices less than $i$ satisfying $q$ is $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A decidable predicate $q$ on the natural numbers
